title: Who owes me
caption: It is month-end and Salma cannot remember who still owes her. Lumi tells her story.
linkedin_text: Cash Flow Watch in ScoreMyBiz lists every customer who owes you, with the amount and the days overdue, and a one-tap WhatsApp reminder. Marking a payment as paid, in full or in part, lands in the book.

cast.salma: Salma, a middle-aged Indian woman who runs a tile shop, in a plum cotton kurta with reading glasses on a chain

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a navy blazer and white top, facing the camera in a bright tile shop with colourful tile samples on the walls behind her, a warm smile.
scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Lumi. This is Salma's story. It is month-end, and she cannot remember who still owes her money.
scenes.sub: Hi, I'm Lumi. This is Salma's story. It is month-end, and she cannot remember who still owes her money.
scenes.title: Who owes me

scenes.clip: {salma} at her shop counter with a worn handwritten notebook, rubbing her forehead, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: Customers promised to pay. Some did, some did not. The notebook does not say since when.
